items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: plays it the way it was meant to be played, and not with modern chords and ride cymbal and all of that, it’s very authentic... Armand Piron

ctx.x: I mean I actually started it full time on August 29. And it’s really my best friend in music, Chris Tyle, the trumpet player and cornet player. He’s got a band called the Silver Leaf Jazz Band, at the Royal Sonesta Hotel in the Cancan Jazz Cafe. And I’m going to get in trouble for saying this, I think it’s the only authentic New Orleans style band in the city, that really plays the music of King Oliver and Jelly Roll Morton, Armand Piron, Freddie Keppard, and plays it the way it was meant to be played, and not…
Well good for you. That should be doing what you want.
